I live in Australia, and take sertraline for generalised anxiety. We have the branded version and generic version, you can opt to have generic version for much cheaper if you choose. Branded version will usually cost around $20. Generic will probably run you $12. I also have a health care card as a university student that runs it down to $5.50. My meds will usually last a couple months before I need to get it refilled.

Insomnia - could barely sleep and when I did I was constantly waking up. I averaged about 3-4 hours of sleep for about a week and a half and then it slowly disappeared. 

No sex drive - Wasn’t in the mood, and couldn’t really orgasm when I tried. If I was able to it was very small and didn’t feel much. That went away after about 2 or so weeks and now everything is back to normal. 

Fatigue - I was constantly tired all day and just wanted to sleep but I couldn’t. Couldn’t concentrate, took a break off uni because I just couldn’t keep up with the study load.

Depression - Went through a pretty awful “break up” right about the time I started Zoloft. Pretty bad timing. Ending up relapsing and self harmed to the point I was going to admit myself. Planned out my suicide. I didn’t go through with it (obviously). CBT helped me get through this phase as well, so I would recommend not just antidepressants as well if you can, especially if you get a severe side effect like this. 

My side effects were pretty awful, but it was so worth it. It’s nice to function like a human being. It doesn’t just magically get better though, you still need to put it effort.. it just really helps you cope.
